title: World generator qualifying social event injection
objective: Ensure back/app/world/generator.py produces qualifying SocialEventSpec values (confrontation or withdrawal event types) in the fallback path at a controlled low frequency (~1-in-7 days), so that the T4 event-aware detection path can actually trigger during real simulation runs. Also ensure the companion test module test_p32_t2_world_generator_social_event.py is present and all tests pass.
exact_scope: The implementation is already present in the codebase. The executor must: (1) verify generator.py has the _FALLBACK_QUALIFYING_EVENTS rotation and the (world_day % 7 == 0) injection trigger in _fallback_snapshot(), (2) verify test_p32_t2_world_generator_social_event.py exists and all 12 tests pass, (3) verify no existing tests are broken (all 900 tests pass), (4) make any missing or incomplete changes if the above is not fully satisfied, and (5) produce a single well-scoped commit that covers the complete P32-T2 deliverable. The commit must include both generator.py and test_p32_t2_world_generator_social_event.py as the two central changed files for this task.
constraints: Do not modify tick_bridge.py — T4 detection logic (T4_QUALIFYING_EVENT_TYPES, _detect_qualifying_t4_social_event) is already correct and frozen
Do not modify domain models (models.py, enums.py) — schema is frozen
Do not modify appraisal_settlement.py or any other engine file
Do not modify arc definitions in back/app/world/arcs.py except to verify arc social_event propagation is correct
Qualifying days must be deterministic: the same world_day must always return the same social_event value
Frequency must be low: no more than 1-in-7 days in the fallback path should carry a qualifying event
The docstring in generator.py must accurately describe the injection trigger condition as (world_day % 7) == 0

Do not break test_social_event_schema.py — particularly test_generator_produces_social_event_none which asserts social_event=None for specific days (3, 5, 7, 10, 12, 16, 17, 20, 24). Day 21 and 28 are the qualifying injection days in fallback span, so days 17, 20, 24 must remain None
Prior attempt failure was 'allowed_files scope + empty commit' — the executor must produce a commit that covers the real P32-T2 deliverable, not a docstring-only trivial fix
acceptance_criteria: back/app/world/generator.py contains _FALLBACK_QUALIFYING_EVENTS with confrontation and withdrawal SocialEventSpec entries
back/app/world/generator.py _fallback_snapshot() injects a qualifying social event when (world_day % 7) == 0
Days 21 and 28 in the fallback span return a non-None social_event with event_type in {confrontation, withdrawal}
Days 17, 20, and 24 return social_event=None (existing test_social_event_schema.py assertion must still pass)
get_world_snapshot() is deterministic: calling it twice for the same day always returns the same social_event

back/tests/test_p32_t2_world_generator_social_event.py exists with at least 12 tests covering: schema validity, qualifying event frequency (>=2 in days 17-37), low-frequency bound (<=5 per 7-day window), determinism, arc phase propagation, SocialEventSpec schema validity, and multi-day simulation integration
All tests in test_social_event_schema.py pass (13 tests)
Full test suite passes (all 900 tests, no regressions)
A git commit is produced with message scoped to P32-T2 that references both generator.py and test_p32_t2_world_generator_social_event.py as the deliverable
required_tests: All fallback days (17-37) produce valid WorldSnapshot instances — no Pydantic validation errors
At least 2 days in the fallback range 17-37 carry a qualifying social event (confrontation or withdrawal)
No 7-consecutive-day window within the fallback range has more than 5 qualifying events
Calling get_world_snapshot() twice with the same day always returns the same social_event value
Day 21 (known qualifying day: 21 % 7 == 0) returns a confrontation or withdrawal social_event with all four required fields populated
Arc days 3-16 propagate social_event from their ArcPhase definition (None when not defined, spec when defined)
Every injected SocialEventSpec has event_type, intensity, reciprocity, and expectedness all set (not None)
A 14-day simulation run starting at day 17 detects at least 1 qualifying social_event in world snapshots
A 10-day run (days 17-26) detects at least 1 qualifying day (day 21 must qualify)
non_goals: Do not activate T4 relational residual creation — that is P32-T3 and later
Do not change T4 gate conditions or absorption thresholds
Do not add any new arc phases or modify arc social_event definitions
Do not expand the set of qualifying event types beyond confrontation and withdrawal
Do not inject qualifying events into arc days (days 3-16) — injection is fallback path only
Do not implement any routing or filtering on social_event.target_id
Do not modify settlement logic or growth buffers
